facts.fact: The ILO says the General Labour Inspectorate's portal, launched in Praia on 3 November 2026, includes an AI-powered virtual assistant that answers workers' and employers' questions on labour law, including in Kriolu.

CPV.note: The assistant answers general questions on labour law and is a public-facing chatbot, not a tool giving diagnoses, scores or decisions inside a sector system.
The 20 inspectors' capacity-building is on extending inspection to the informal economy, not digital skills.
No programme teaching the public digital skills is stated; training for users is only to follow the launch.

facts.fact: The ILO reports that the Inspectorate's new portal, launched 3 November 2026, includes text-to-speech, keyboard navigation, screen-reader compatibility and improved colour contrast for persons with disabilities.
